svg.title: Tournament round — pairing, reserved rooms, check-in and result
svg.desc: Use case: a scheduled Swiss round. The maintenance tick pairs the round and creates one reserved GameRoom per pairing; each player checks in to bind their seat; when the game ends, the persisted result is recorded and standings are recomputed for the next round.
svg.text: Tournament round — pairing, reserved rooms, check-in and result
Use case: a scheduled Swiss round. The maintenance tick pairs the round and creates one reserved GameRoom per pairing; each player checks in
to bind their seat; when the game ends, the persisted result is recorded and standings are recomputed for the next round.
the game is played as in UML 11 and saved as in UML 12
